messages:
vic: Found a confusing mismatch in the /classify endpoint docs. The OpenAPI enum for `label` is listed as UPPER_SNAKE (e.g. `POSITIVE`, `NEGATIVE`) but the JS SDK examples use lowercase strings (`'positive'`). Runtime accepts both for now, but we should pick a canonical casing and update examples + add a migration note.

ana: Thanks — this is tripping up customers doing strict type checks. Product prefers keeping UPPER_SNAKE in the public API surface so it's explicit. Devex preference was lowercase to match many ML label sets though.

kevin: Technical note: the runtime normalizes labels case-insensitively, but OpenAPI drives generated clients which become strict enums. If OpenAPI uses UPPER_SNAKE, some client languages will emit enum values that users must use exactly. Changing OpenAPI will trigger client updates.

vic: Proposal: set OpenAPI to UPPER_SNAKE (runtime canonical), update all docs examples (curl/python/js/go) to use UPPER_SNAKE, but include a tiny migration snippet showing how to convert existing lowercase labels: `label = label.toUpperCase().replace('-', '_')`. Also add a one-line compat note: runtime accepts lowercase but generated clients may not.

ana: I can open a docs PR with the example fixes and a migration note. Can we also add a small table listing the canonical enums and a short explanation for the casing decision? That helps customers integrate.

kevin: Please also add a test in the docs preview harness that tries the lowercase value and asserts the runtime returns 200 (so preview demonstrates backwards compat while we update clients). And add an OpenAPI change suggestion but mark it as a separate repo PR so we can coordinate client releases.

docs-ci-bot: docs-ci-bot: PR 7890 opened by @ana -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7890. Staging preview: https://deploy-preview-7890--docs.redwood.ai. Includes updated examples and migration notes.

vic: Left a few comments asking for side-by-side snippets: (1) the curl payload showing UPPER_SNAKE, (2) the JS SDK call using the generated enum literal, and (3) a snippet showing runtime-robust conversion for user data.

ana: Updated PR per comments. Added table of canonical enums and a short paragraph: "Why UPPER_SNAKE? It avoids accidental collisions with model output tokens and aligns with OpenAPI enum generator defaults." Also included one-liners: Python `label = label.upper().replace('-', '_')` and Go example using `strings.ToUpper` + `strings.ReplaceAll`.

product-bot: product-bot: pinging stakeholders for client release plan. Suggested coordination window next week for JS/Go patch releases.

kevin: LGTM on docs text. I'll open the OpenAPI schema PR after docs merge so client generation can be scheduled. Please include the OpenAPI diff in your PR description for reviewers to examine.

ana: Tests in preview harness passing, preview shows all examples using UPPER_SNAKE. I'll merge once CI green. Thanks everyone.

vic: Merged. Kept a small note in the changelog: "Classify: label enum canonicalized to UPPER_SNAKE; runtime accepts lowercase for now — update generated clients when new SDKs ship."

kevin: Filed OpenAPI PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/openapi/pull/432. Devex: please schedule client regen and release notes for next patch.

ana: Announced to #support with paste-ready examples for agents. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
